'''Darkstone Grove''' was a small grove located on the northern edge of the [[Nightmare Lands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]], east of the [[Crysfang Glade]] and west of the [[Lake of Unseen]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darkstone Grove appears in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
